screen.modserver.nation_map.controls: Wheel: zoom | Drag: pan | Right-click: inspect or dispute | Esc: close
modserver.map.dimension: Travel to the selected dimension to inspect this chunk.
modserver.map.active: Dispute in progress. %s is attacking, %s is defending.
modserver.map.free: This chunk is unclaimed. You can dispute land that belongs to another nation.
modserver.map.found: Found a nation with /nation create <name> to dispute territory.
modserver.map.own: This territory belongs to your nation.
modserver.map.agreement: Your agreement with %s prevents a dispute.
modserver.map.wait: You can dispute this chunk in %s s.
modserver.map.funds: The dispute costs %s coins. Your treasury holds %s.
modserver.map.offer: On confirmation, %s will pay %s coins. %s will have %s min to defend the chunk.
modserver.map.heading: [nation] Territory map · North ↑ · Chunk %s, %s
modserver.map.legend: □ Unclaimed  ▣ Border  ▧ Disputed · Your chunk is underlined · Click to inspect
modserver.npc.found: First, found a nation with /nation create <name>.
modserver.npc.rules: Commit any number of troops across a shared border. One duel every five seconds. Defenders win ties.
modserver.npc.defense: Deploy armies before the battle. They roll even when you are offline.
modserver.npc.actions: Planning opens the campaign map. Accepting starts a battle on your border.
modserver.npc.approach: Move closer to the envoy to accept the challenge.
modserver.npc.changed: This territory no longer belongs to %s. Speak to the envoy again.
modserver.npc.keep: Use /nation defend %s %s to keep the chunk.
modserver.npc.win: If time runs out without a defense, %s takes the territory.
modserver.war.idle: At war with %s · No active disputes
modserver.war.disputed: %1$s disputes your territory. Defend it with /nation defend %2$s %3$s.
modserver.war.invasion: %1$s attacks your chunk %2$s, %3$s. Defend it with /nation defend %2$s %3$s.
modserver.war.cancelled: The dispute over chunk %s was cancelled

gov.oil.dry: Survey complete. This chunk has no recoverable oil.
gov.oil.found: Oil field registered. Estimated reserve: %s whole buckets.

gov.oil.aim: Aim at a Create fluid tank or oil barrel built entirely inside this concession.

gov.oil.offer: Export %1$s buckets of %2$s for %3$s national coins?
gov.title: National government
gov.owner: Only the nation owner can open the panel. Found a nation with /nation create <name>.
gov.name: Name
gov.type: Click to edit %s in chat. Press Enter to save.
gov.invalidName: Use a unique name of 3–24 characters: letters, digits, underscores or spaces between words.

gov.bound: Reserve linked. Open the treasury to review stock and sell.
gov.chest.none: Aim at your chest and use /nation reserve.

gov.chest.look: Aim directly at a regular chest within reach.
gov.short: The chest does not contain that quantity.
gov.sale: Sell %s × %s from the reserve for %s coins?
gov.changed: This offer is no longer valid. Request a new quote.

gov.max: Garrison is already at its highest level.

gov.notOwned: This chunk does not belong to your nation.

tac.title: Tactical map
tac.hint: Select your chunk, then a rival. Drag to pan. Scroll to zoom.
tac.rules: Commit any number of troops across a shared border. One duel every five seconds. Defenders win ties.
tac.inspect: Open the tactical map to choose an origin and commit armies.
tac.panel: Buy armies and deploy them on your territory.
tac.panelHint: Select a rival chunk on the tactical map to battle.
tac.commands: Army: %s coins. /nation tactics buy <qty> · deploy <x> <z> <qty> · move <x> <z> <targetX> <targetZ> <qty> · roll <x> <z> <targetX> <targetZ> <troops> · exchange <x> <z> · fire <x> <z> <targetX> <targetZ>. Use /nation tactics <x> <z> to inspect. Add ground, air or naval after the quantity to choose a branch. Nuclear: nuclear buy <x> <z> · nuclear fire <x> <z> <targetX> <targetZ>.
tac.owner: Only a playing nation owner can issue orders.
tac.funds: The treasury cannot cover this purchase.
tac.origin: Select a chunk your nation owns.
tac.exchangeLow: The exchange costs 6 armies in this chunk. One must remain.
tac.range: Select an origin with a missile and a target 1–3 edges away.
tac.occupation: Defenders here: %1$s. This shot needs at least %2$s so one survives.
tac.adjacent: The two chunks must share an edge.
tac.commit: Choose between one and the number of troops at your origin.
tac.engaged: A battle is already under way here.
tac.changed: The board changed. Review the current forces before ordering again.
tac.hit: Missile hit %1$s, %2$s. The defender lost %3$s armies.
tac.round: Attack %1$s · Defense %2$s · Losses %3$s / %4$s. The defender holds %5$s, %6$s.
tac.forecast: Defense: %1$s dice. At %2$s edges, a missile removes %3$s armies if one can remain.
tac.missileRules: Missile range is 3 chunks. It removes 3, 2 or 1 armies by distance. One defender must remain.
tac.pick.deployment: Click your chunk on the map to reinforce it.
tac.pick.attackFrom: Click your attacking chunk on the map.
tac.pick.attackTo: Click a rival chunk sharing an edge with yours.
tac.pick.workshop: Click your chunk with at least 7 armies.
tac.pick.launchFrom: Click your chunk that holds the missile.
tac.noMissileTargets: No eligible targets within three chunk edges of this base.
tac.pick.launchTo: Choose a rival chunk marked with gold corners.
tac.pick.silo: Select one of your chunks to store or launch a nuclear missile.
tac.pick.epicenter: Select a rival chunk within 3 edges. The blast covers the highlighted 3×3 area.
tac.noNuclear: Buy a nuclear missile at this silo before launching.
tac.nuclearPreview:
3×3 chunks · %s troops at risk
Includes your own and allied troops.
tac.note.nuclear: The blast clears garrisons and troops in combat across all nine chunks. Borders stay in place. Treaties protect the selected center.
tac.nuclearHit: Nuclear strike at %1$s, %2$s. The 3×3 area lost %3$s troops.
tac.attackTotal:
Attackers %1$s · Defenders %2$s
One duel every 5 seconds.
tac.buildTotal:
Armies after exchange: %1$s
Missiles in this chunk: %2$s
tac.note.buy: Purchased armies enter your reserve. Use Deploy to put them on the map.
tac.note.deploy: These armies defend the chunk, even while you are offline.
tac.note.attack: Each side rolls one die per duel. Ties favor the defender. Surviving attackers occupy the chunk once the defense falls.
tac.note.build: The six armies come from the selected chunk. The missile is stored there.
tac.note.launch: At distances of 1, 2 or 3 edges, a missile removes 3, 2 or 1 armies. One defender must survive.
tac.noMissile: Choose a launch site that holds a missile.
tac.missileDistance: The target must be within 1–3 edges of the launch site.
tac.outside: Pan back to the selected chunk or choose it again.
tac.navigate: Drag to pan. Scroll to zoom.
tac.reselect: To change a selection, use its button and pick another chunk on the map.
tac.pick.moveFrom: Pick one of your chunks with at least two armies.
tac.pick.moveTo: Pick one of your chunks sharing an edge with the origin.
tac.moveDestination: Choose a destination your nation owns.
tac.moveLeave: Leave at least one army at the origin.
tac.note.move: A move transfers deployed armies across one shared edge. One army stays at the origin.
tac.front: Battle against %1$s · Attack %2$s / Defense %3$s · Next duel %4$ss
tac.fieldReport: %1$s has %2$s troops attacking. %3$s has %4$s defending. One duel every five seconds.
tac.march: Attack launched: %1$s troops against %2$s defenders. First duel in 5 seconds.
tac.branch.tip.ground: Against navy, your 1 counts as 2. Air has that edge against you.
tac.branch.tip.air: Against ground, your 1 counts as 2. Navy has that edge against you.
tac.branch.tip.naval: Against air, your 1 counts as 2. Ground has that edge against you.
tac.branch.tip.mixed: Send a proportional mix. Each duel draws one troop from each side.
tac.branch.rules: Air has the edge over ground, ground over navy, and navy over air. With the edge, a 1 counts as 2. Defenders win ties.
tac.branchLow: Too few troops of this branch at the origin.
tac.pick.sendFrom: Choose one of your chunks with troops.
tac.pick.sendTo: Choose a chunk owned by an ally.
tac.allyTarget: Choose allied territory. Form an alliance with /nation alliance "Country".
tac.note.send: Form an alliance with /nation alliance "Country". Troops travel %s minutes per chunk and join the allied garrison on arrival.
tac.sent: Reinforcements en route to %2$s · Troops: %1$s · %3$s chunks · %4$s.
tac.convoy.commands: Allied aid: /nation tactics send <x> <z> <tx> <tz> <amount> [branch]. /nation tactics shipments [page] shows journeys.
tac.convoy.heading: Reinforcements in transit
tac.convoy.turnedBack: Shipment from %1$s to %2$s: delivery unavailable. %3$s troops are heading home.
tac.convoy.returned: %1$s recovered its shipment of %3$s troops to %2$s.
tac.convoy.waitForRoom: %1$s needs room at the origin or in reserve for %3$s returning troops.
council.title: Council of Nations

council.noChest: Bind a reserve chest to see your resources.
council.noPeers: Other countries will appear here when they are founded.
council.ratifyHint: Propose a treaty. It takes effect when the other country accepts.
council.envoyTreaties: This NPC country signs treaties immediately.
council.pactHint: Prevents either nation from attacking the other.
council.allyHint: Prevents attacks and lets you send reinforcements.
council.peaceHint: Ends the war and restores neutrality.
council.routeHint: Choose an origin, troop type and quantity on the tactical map. Each chunk adds 10 minutes to the trip.
council.needAlliance: Ratify an alliance with this country to send reinforcements.
council.noLetters: Your messages with this country will appear here.
council.noOffers: There are no open proposals with this country.
council.invalid: Choose a valid country and terms.
council.current: This treaty would not change the current relation.
council.duplicate: An identical proposal is already pending.
council.full: Resolve pending proposals before sending more.
council.gone: This proposal is no longer available.
council.chests: Both countries need accessible, bound reserve chests.
council.stock: The seller's reserve no longer holds that quantity.
council.space: The buyer's reserve chest needs more space.
council.funds: The buyer's treasury cannot cover the price.
council.overflow: The seller's treasury cannot receive this payment.
council.envoyOnly: NPC countries can sign treaties and receive allied troops.
council.proposed: Proposal sent. Track it under Proposals.
council.settled: Trade completed. The goods and coins have been transferred.
council.sent: Dispatch delivered to the country's mailbox.
council.broadcast: Dispatch delivered to your allied delegations.
council.noAllies: There are no player-run allies to receive this dispatch.
council.invalidText: Enter a message of 1 to 160 plain-text characters.
council.noRoute: Find a peaceful allied chunk in your current dimension.
council.alert: New council activity from %s. Open /nation council.
council.chatHelp: /nation council visit "Country" · pact, ally, peace, trade, letter, circular, convoy, accept, decline, withdraw
gov.reinforcements: Each level adds one ground troop to your reserve each day.
council.tradeLimits: Enter 1–3,456 units and a total price of 1–1,000,000,000 coins.
council.shortStock: Only %2$s × %1$s in your chest. Choose another resource or lower the quantity.
council.salePreview: If accepted, you deliver %1$s × %2$s and receive %3$s coins.
